# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and Graphite** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback on Skia m152. The release also strengthens pixel and native-object lifetime safety, adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package, and improves HarfBuzz shaping performance.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Exposes Graphite support for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can adopt Skia's modern GPU backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous readback. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object lifetimes made safer** — Fixes use-after-free risks in SKRegion iteration and SKPixmap subsets, and releases raster pixel memory when SKImage creation fails. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Data and text helpers avoid unnecessary allocations** — Improves SKData.SaveTo and encoded-text retrieval efficiency while preserving their existing behavior. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Runtime-effect uniforms reset cleanly** — Reset disposes the previous uniform buffer, and uniform lookup initialization is sized for the known uniform count. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **HarfBuzz stream conversion releases native resources** — Converting a non-memory-backed stream to a HarfBuzz blob no longer leaves its SKStreamAsset undisposed. ([#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET package introduced** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and validates Vulkan support on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Nano Server font support uses FreeType** — Provides reliable font support for Nano Server through the FreeType backend. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple native symbols packaged** — Produces symbol packages for Apple native assets to aid diagnostics. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes native stream cleanup when creating blobs.
